title: A Kingdom Devastated - Egy elpusztult ország
grammar: Mediopassive & destruction verbs: elpusztul, romba dől, felég, megsemmisül

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe the winter crossing of the frozen Danube by the Mongols.
I can explain Rogerius mester's Carmen Miserabile and its historical significance.
I can use mediopassive destruction verbs (elpusztul, romba dől, felég).
I can recount IV. Béla's refuge in the island fortress of Trau (Trogir).
